'''2024 Charity Jonny Chu DS AOBS''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]] · [[Twi'lek Advisor]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Chu DS AOBS.txt|Download]]
